source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Whenever an enemy unit Falls Back while within Engagement Range of any of your units with this ability, each of its models takes a Desperate Escape test. If the unit is Battle-shocked as well, subtract 1 from each test. This ability does not affect **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**.

trigger.enemyWithinEngagementRangeOf: one or more friendly units with this ability

effect.desperateEscapeTests: every model in the enemy unit
